concept_to_guide._comment: Concept-to-guide mapping. When a term (key) is detected in bug/RCA content, guides whose filenames contain ANY of the listed patterns (values) are auto-checked. Use this for terms that don't literally appear in guide filenames but semantically belong to a specific guide. Patterns are matched as substrings against the normalized filename (lowercase, no .pdf). Built from actual book table-of-contents analysis.
